notes: «بمكة سنة سبع وستين ومائتين» gives the place and date of the hearing, not a link. «8 -» is the report number.

Abu Ja'far Muhammad b. Ali is named only in the words after the chain, and he speaks and answers inside Ibn Ata's narrated encounter (rule 11). He is not added: whether he is the last link or only in the scene is a ruling.
